conviction_note: Small and near-zero: the H1 loss very likely narrows (Q2 shooting-basis monthly sales +4.4% YoY, Q1 OP +8.5%), but all of that is visible in public 月次, there is no H1 guide, no analyst coverage, the company has not revised its full-year plan at an H1 print in the last three years (it did not revise FY2026.2 even while missing OP 2,870 by 27%), and this name's last eleven print reactions were all inside +/-1.4%; abs_move 1.0 at p_up 53 gives +0.06, while the findings sum to +0.30 because each carries its own small positive size and the sign uncertainty sits only in p_up.
bar: No company H1 guide (短信 2026-07-13: 第2四半期累計の業績予想は非公表) and no analyst consensus (IFIS/kabuyoho target price null). The only bar is last year's H1: consolidated sales 14,372m, OP -462m, ordinary -434m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120250929563870.pdf). print_vs_bar is H1 consolidated sales against 14,372m, estimated at about +1% from the shooting-basis monthly cumulative +1.4% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260824524934.pdf), discounted for Q1's 2.8pt gap between consolidated (-3.8%) and shooting basis (-1.0%). Full-year plan sales 33,600 / OP 2,450 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260626582018.pdf). The bar is not a market expectation, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged from prior, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 0.49 (margin shorts exceed longs; scraped, baseline). The 株主優待 record date is August only (https://yutai-guide.daiwair.co.jp/stock/detail/2305), so a short-heavy margin book in October is residual hedging rather than a crowded directional bet; not a squeeze setup of size given the name moves under 1.5% on prints. No option market, no skew. Run-up -1.52% 20d, +0.78% 5d; priced_lean +0.23.

findings.finding: H1 operating loss very likely narrows versus last year's -462m: Q1 OP was 229m (+8.5%) and Q2 (Jun-Aug) shooting-basis monthly sales were 6,198m against 5,935m (+4.4%), after last year's Q2 ran an OP of about -673m (-10.3% margin) on 6,528m consolidated sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's H1 print (2025-10-14, 15:30) carried a widening Q2 loss (kabutan headline '6-8月期(2Q)経常は赤字拡大') and the stock fell 0.49% the next session (Yahoo closes 2045 -> 2035). Q1 FY2027 (2026-07-13, OP +8.5%) rose 1.41% next session. No reaction in the last eleven exceeded 1.4% on the closes checked.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the monthly series is public and anyone can compute Q2 +4.4%. What is not in the price is the consolidated OP figure itself (completion basis, cost side, store closures) and the kabutan headline flipping from 赤字拡大 to 赤字縮小, which retail reads; the stock is -6.7% over three months and near its 52-week low of 1,720 (kabuyoho), which is not what a price that had fully credited a narrowing loss would look like, though structural customer declines (-7% to -15% a month) explain that too.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 2026-07-13 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260626582018.pdf) shows OP +8.5% and segment profit +23.5% in photos; prior-year H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120250929563870.pdf) supplies the base. Same company, different documents; the monthly and the Q1 短信 overlap for March-May.

findings.finding: The September 2026 月次 is released in the same 15:30 batch as the H1 短信 (as on 2025-10-14), against an easy comparison (Sept 2025 sales 2,360m, -10.6% YoY, customers -16.1%) and with one more non-working day (Silver Week 9/19-9/23: three holidays against two in Sept 2025) in a weekend-driven business; but August 2026 customers ran -15.0%, so the sign is a weak lean only.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Monthly releases alone moved the stock -0.62% (Jul 月次, 2026-08-17), +0.54% (Aug 月次, 2026-09-14), -0.15% (Oct 2025 月次) and -0.64% after the Dec 2025 月次 (kabutan: '１２月売上高が７カ月連続前年下回る').
findings.why_not_priced: September's number has not been published; the only priced information is the August print (-8.7%) and the structural customer decline. The calendar effect and the -10.6% base are knowable but not aggregated anywhere for this name.
findings.independence: Calendar from the Cabinet Office 国民の祝日 list (https://www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/gaiyou.html); August 2026 月次 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260824524934.pdf) points the other way on customer count.

outside_window.finding: Whether the full-year OP plan of 2,450m (+16.9%) is reachable depends on the Oct-Nov 七五三 peak against easy comps (Oct 2025 -7.3%, Nov 2025 -7.1%); a revision, if any, has historically come at Q3 (2024-01-17) or not at all.

searched_and_found_nothing: 業績予想の修正 / 配当予想の修正 for 2305 on kabutan disclosure lists 2025-09 through 2026-10: none filed; FY2026.2 and FY2025.2 show only 初 and 実 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2305&mode=k)
Shareholder returns at prior H1 prints: 2025-10-14 batch held only the H1 短信 and Sept 月次, no buyback or 優待 change (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2305&nmode=0&date=20251000)
Analyst coverage / IFIS consensus: target price null, no rating (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=2305)
Dividend policy: payout target 33.3%, FY2027 planned 50 yen year-end, interim 0 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260406598919.pdf); nothing pointing to a change at H1
Other disclosures 2026: officer changes, parent-company (トーランス・ジャパン 23.05%) results, governance report; nothing price-relevant
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2305 (Q1 短信 stamped 2026-07-13 15:30; kabutan article on the 2025-10-14 H1 print: '10月14日大引け後(15:30)に決算を発表')
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely; the company did not revise FY2026.2 despite missing OP by 27% and revises, if ever, at Q3. Returns: none expected; interim dividend 0 by policy, no buyback or 優待 change at the last two H1 prints. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: H1 is seasonally loss-making (-750, -531, -462 OP in the last three years), so 進捗率 against the full-year plan is negative by construction; the useful comparison is the loss against those three years, likely the narrowest of the four.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Margin ratio 0.49 as a squeeze setup
rejected_candidates.detail: Already carried in priced_lean_pct (margin_overhang +0.155); not an independent finding, and the August-only 優待 record date makes the short side likely hedging residue.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Shichi-go-san cohort shrinkage (births of 2019/2021/2023 below 2018/2020/2022) as a negative for H2
rejected_candidates.detail: Bears on the Oct-Nov peak and the full-year plan, which resolve at Q3 (January 2027); the in-window part is already in the customer-count series of finding 1 and 2.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the priced lean (+0.23) and cuts slightly against the 3-month drift (-6.7%); the strongest positive the release could carry (a held plan with an improving H1, a buyback, a dividend change) was looked for at the last two H1 prints and none came, so the upside is a narrower-loss headline only, and the honest read is that the price already holds nearly all of this.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a finding resting on a public 月次 series moves p_up toward 50), applied by symmetry to a positive: p_up 55 -> 53, expected_move 0.10 -> 0.06; finding sizes left unchanged because the partly-priced caveat had already shrunk them once.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): not triggered, both findings positive; the strongest positive was looked for and recorded in baseline_tension.
